cres_lime.desc: lime kick / vacuum-blade crescent ribbon (swing plane, head at the left)

cres_fire.desc: fire crescent / flame sheet, orange-gold to magenta

streak.desc: long thin streak along a (tint it)

leaf.desc: leaf / petal flake (tint lime or amber)

disc_lime.desc: Dendro disc decal: lime swirl, bright rim

ripple.desc: ripple / wind ring (near white, tint it)

dome_lo.desc: dome shell segment, lower band (ground ring)

dome_hi.desc: dome shell segment, upper band (narrow top)

fan_fire.desc: 180-degree flame fan sheet on the floor

flame_tongue.desc: vertical flame tongue, pivot at its root

blade.desc: radial ground blade, pivot at its root

cure_beam.desc: pale-gold beam, pivot at its foot

cure_burst.desc: white-gold burst sphere with a gold ring

cure_emblem.desc: gold emblem: spire, star, scroll arms, crescent

cocoon_disc.doc: Entrance: the glowing lime floor disc under the cocoon (at the floor point). {life}

cocoon_glow.doc: Entrance / transformation: the cocoon core brightens (glow ramp, 18 t). At the core.

whiteout.doc: Entrance whiteout / big flash: a white-yellow glow ball (8 t). At the core.

cocoon_burst.doc: Entrance t79: crystal shard star, two lime wing crescents, cyan wind ring. At the core.

motes.doc: Moonlight motes rising around the point (idle sparkle, charge, death). 6 cards.

land.doc: Landing: a mint ripple on the floor, drifting leaves, moss dust. At the floor point.

glint.doc: A small white-lime glint (tells, foot sparkles). Billboard.

kick_rise.doc: H1 hit 1: the tall rising flip-kick crescent (sagittal, sweeping up and back) + ground splash. At her feet, rotated as her (yaw).

kick_axe.doc: H1 hit 2: the huge diagonal axe-kick crescent from above-behind down to the floor ahead (r about 5). At her feet, rotated as the kick.

ground_wave.doc: H1 hit 2 ground wave: lime blades erupt one after another along 6 blocks ahead, plus a streak on the floor. At the floor point, rotated as the line.

shard_tell.doc: H2 tell: one arm shard glows into a lime crescent blade (13 t). At the shard.

sweep.doc: H2 360-degree low sweep (r 3, active 6 t): two knee-high lime crescents turning around her. At her feet.

spiral_jump.doc: H2 spiral jump: two lime spiral ribbons wind up around her. At her feet.

orb_star.doc: H2 star flash at the orb (and any white 4-point flash). Billboard.

orb_kick.doc: H2 orb burst as it is kicked down: lime starburst and two white wind crescents circling it.

disc_fall.doc: H2 the Dendro disc drops {h} blocks onto the floor point in 3 t (call at the floor point; the disc starts h above).

disc_impact.doc: H2 disc impact (r 2.5): lime disc splash, burst, ripple, dust puffs and leaves. At the floor point.

dash_charge.doc: H3 mote charge (10 t): motes converge on her and a faint floor glow. At her feet.

dash_streak.doc: H3 dash: a 5.5-block speed streak along the dash path. At her start point, rotated along the dash.

kick_burst.doc: H3 kick + Dendro ring r 3.5: white-lime burst at the foot, flung blades, a floor ripple and the all-around crescent ring. At her feet.

vac_crouch.doc: H4 crouch: the kicking leg glows lime (9 t). At the foot.

vac_glint.doc: H4 tell: a green spike flares behind her, a horizontal cyan-white glint line and a 4-point flare at the foot. At the foot, rotated as her.

vac_stomp.doc: H4 stomp: yellow-green ground flare at the foot as the blade rises. At the floor point.

vac_trail.doc: H4 travelling blade, every 2 t at the blade prop: small blades and leaves left behind, a dark-green scar. At the prop (floor height).

tf_sheath.doc: Transformation: the green vertical glow sheath wraps her lower body. At her chest.

tf_sphere.doc: Transformation: core flash, then the light sphere r 2.5 (6 t). At her chest.

tf_ripples.doc: Transformation: concentric ripple rings r 4-5 (a floor ring and two vertical arcs) and radial speed lines. At her chest; the floor ring is drawn 1.6 below.

wing_band.doc: B1 hit: the bright yellow-green ground slash band along the wing path (r 4 arc on the floor). At the floor under her, rotated as the strike.

wing_flare.doc: B1 trailing vertical crescent flare (2-3 b) at the end of the arc. At the wing tip.

pyro_switch.doc: Wings turn Pyro: a magenta-pink rim glow pulse around her (1 t swap). At her chest.

dendro_switch.doc: Wings turn back to Dendro: a lime glow pulse. At her chest.

fire_swing.doc: B2 swing: a giant flame sheet in the swing plane (r 4) with white wind streaks. At her chest, rotated as the swing (roll the plane with an execute rotated / the diagonal variant).

fire_swing_d.doc: B2 swing, diagonal plane (upper-left to lower-right). At her chest, rotated as her.

fire_spawn.doc: B2: a fire crescent appears in the air (small puff + embers). At the crescent.

fire_trail.doc: B2 / B3: a short flame puff left behind a moving fire crescent (call every 1-2 t at the prop).

fire_land.doc: B2 crescent landing: fire splash r 1.2 with a 2.5-block vertical flame streak. At the floor point.

flame_slam.doc: B3 slam: two vertical flame crescents rise at the wing tips. At her chest, rotated as her.

flame_fan.doc: B3 eruption: the 180-degree front flame fan r 4.5, 2.5 tall (t28-32) with a scorched floor sheet. At the floor under her, rotated as her.

flame_trail.doc: B3 low glide: a flame line on the floor (call every 2 t at the wing-tip floor point).

orb_charge.doc: B4 wing-wrap charge (14 t): a lime core grows at her chest with converging streaks.

orb_launch.doc: B4 orb release: a lime ring flash and sparkle where the orb leaves her. At the orb.

orb_burst.doc: B4 orb burst r 2.5-3: starburst, radial V-shaped ground blades, a floor ripple, leaves. At the floor under the orb.

cocoon_ball.doc: B4 wing ball (12 t): a lime glow inside the ball. At its centre.

rel_fold.doc: B5 fold: small lime butterfly glyphs float up around her (20 t). At her chest.

rel_flare.doc: B5 whirl: the pulsing lime 4-point star flare at her side with converging lines (call 2-3 times over the 20 t whirl). At the flare point.

rel_slashes.doc: B5 whirl: thin lime slash streaks whip around her (4 cards). At her chest.

rel_ground_flash.doc: B5 E-18: a lime mist cone bursts from the floor under her. At the floor point.

rel_xglint.doc: B5 E-16: two long cyan-white lines cross through her chest as an X (8 blocks each). At her chest (camera-facing).

rel_cage.doc: B5 E-15..-10: the gyroscope ring cage r 4 (three spinning lime rings). At her chest.

rel_pod.doc: B5 E-9..-1: the white-lime core glow grows inside the wrapped pod with inward streaks. At her chest.

rel_dome.doc: B5 detonation E: white flash, then the lime dome grows to radius {r} blocks in 5 t (16 shell segments + cap) and lingers, with a floor shock ring. At the floor under her.

rel_tendrils.doc: B5 E+7: long lime flame-like tendrils stream out radially as she re-emerges. At her chest.

embers.doc: After the blast: amber ember petals and lime motes drift down (E+10..+34). Around her chest.

wing_shatter.doc: B5 E+38 / death: the shrunken lime wings break into shards (12 cards). At her back.

chain_reform.doc: After the groggy turn: lime streaks converge on her side as the crescent chain re-forms (18 t). At the chain point.

coc_apply.doc: 달빛 고치 applied: a maroon swirl ring closes on the player and a salmon glow. At the player's feet.

cure.doc: 달빛 고치 removed (about 20 t): gold beam down (6 t), gold burst + ring (5 t), gold emblem with sparkles (9 t). At the player's feet.

dew_spawn.doc: A 달빛 이슬 orb appears: a cyan-lime floor ripple, a glow and motes. At the orb's floor point.

dew_pulse.doc: Idle pulse of a 달빛 이슬 orb (call every 20 t at the orb): a soft ring on the floor and two rising motes, so it reads on the marble.

death_motes.doc: Death: rising moonlight motes and crystal shards (call every 10-20 t of the 100 t death). Around her chest.

props.fire: B2 fire crescent projectile: the camera-facing golden claw, 1.4 blocks.
props.vblade: H4 vacuum blade: a vertical lime crescent wall facing the flight (in the plane across it, where the blade hit line is), 4 tall from its lower tip 0.9 below the prop (the pj hit row on the floor) and about 2.7 across (x -1.33..+1.33 of the hr 1.5 hit), the thick bright head on top, bulging to the prop's left; fly the prop 0.9 above the floor. Cyclic turn x->y, y->z, z->x of the flat card, chord x4.4, bulge x6.8 (measured by scratchpad mb2/integ/vblade_check.py).
props.orb: B4 coco orb fallback look (when the rig has no orb prop): a lime light sphere 1.7 across.
props.orb_ring: B4 gyroscope ring around an orb (fixed; turn it from the module tick), 2.2 across.
props.dew: 달빛 이슬 heal orb look (camera-facing, 0.9 across).

sounds.cocoon_glow: Cocoon core brightens (entrance t57+, transformation start): rising glassy shimmer.
sounds.cocoon_burst: Cocoon bursts into crystal shards (entrance about t79): bright shatter + wind.
sounds.cocoon_tail: Glittering tail of the burst (2-8 t after cocoon_burst).
sounds.land: Soft landing (entrance t90, revert landing, backflip landings).
sounds.kick_whoosh: Burst-run / kick wind-up whoosh with a leafy crack (H1 hit 1 lead-in): bright air attack, a rising swish and a glint tick on top.
sounds.kick_impact: Kick crescent lands (H1 hits, H3 kick): a thump transient, a big low airy swoosh (pitched down so it rings longer), a leafy crackle and a short airy tail.
sounds.crescent_fly: A crescent wave travels (H1 ground wave, B1 trailing crescent).
sounds.shard_tell: Arm shard glows lime (H2 tell, the chain glow): shimmer chime.
sounds.sweep: 360-degree low sweep kick (H2): thump then a whirling swish and leaf debris.
sounds.spiral_jump: Spiral jump (H2): rising whirl and a low rumble.
sounds.disc_kick: Orb kicked down as the Dendro disc (H2 star flash + kick): bright sparkle and a crack.
sounds.disc_impact: Dendro disc hits the floor (H2 impact): boom with a leafy crackle.
sounds.dash_charge: Mote charge before the dash (H3): rustling glittery shimmer.
sounds.dash: Dash lunge (H3, burst-runs): short airy whoosh.
sounds.dash_kick: Dash kick impact + ring (H3): deep thump, a bright air pop, a leafy burst and a crackling low tail.
sounds.vacuum_glint: Vacuum blade tell glint (H4): sharp crystalline ping.
sounds.vacuum_blade: Foot stomp + blade rise (H4): whoosh and leafy roar.
sounds.vacuum_pass: The blade rushes past (H4 travel): hiss and a low thump.
sounds.transform_glow: Transformation: the cocoon sheath glows and the folded wings open.
sounds.transform_swell: Light sphere + ripple rings + wings unfurl: broad airy swell.
sounds.debuff: 달빛 고치 lands on the player (with the light sphere): curse-like chime burst.
sounds.flap_big: Big wing flap (B3 tell, B5 flight, the glide settle): a deep whump, the membrane body, a low air push and a soft rustle.
sounds.flap_small: Small hover flap (every 13-20 t in butterfly form; quiet): a soft flap and a feathery flutter.
sounds.wing_dive: Bank + dive before the wing strike (B1), the release swoop (B5): a high flap, the swoop and a rushing air tail.
sounds.wing_strike: Wing edge hits and sweeps on (B1): solid hit then a long airy swish with leaf crackle.
sounds.pyro_switch: Wings turn Pyro (1 t swap, 5-12 t before B2 / B3): a soft fire whump, a glassy shimmer as the wing glass recolours, a bright hiss and a crackling tail.
sounds.dendro_switch: Wings turn back to Dendro (before B1 / B4 / B5).
sounds.fire_cres_launch: Wing swing throws the fire crescents (B2, each swing): a low whoosh attack, the roaring flame burst, a wing whump, air and a crackling tail.
sounds.fire_cres_fly: Crescents turn and dive (B2): crackling hiss with an airy streak.
sounds.fire_cres_land: A fire crescent lands (B2, per landing): a sharp pop and crack, a fire puff and a short hiss.
sounds.flame_fan: 180-degree flame eruption (B3): crackling roar, a low boom under it and a long crackling rumble.
sounds.flame_trail: Flame line under the low glide (B3 trail, every 4-6 t; quiet).
sounds.orb_charge: Wing-wrap core charge (B4 before each orb): a thin rising sparkle over a quiet hum.
sounds.orb_launch: Orb released (B4 t19 / t46): soft launch whir.
sounds.orb_fly: Orb flight loop (every 10-12 t while it homes; quiet).
sounds.orb_burst: Orb bursts into radial ground blades (B4): an airy boom, a low thump, a leafy crackle and a glassy sparkle tail.
sounds.cocoon_ball: Wings curl into the ball (B4 t30-42): swirling rustle.
sounds.release_swoop: 달빛 해제 fold + swoop (B5 start): low swoosh.
sounds.release_whirl: 달빛 해제 whirl / cup (B5): airy swishes.
sounds.release_charge: 달빛 해제 charge (flare, X glint, ring cage): rising hum + sparkle; call 2-3 times rising.
sounds.release_wrap: 달빛 해제 wings wrap into the pod (E-9): pressure builds.
sounds.release_boom: 달빛 해제 detonation (E): a broadband boom pitched down for a long body, an airy blast, the sonic crack, a falling beacon tone, crystal and leaf crackle and a low glassy tail.
sounds.wing_shatter: Wings shrink, go flat lime and shatter (B5 E+38 / death).
sounds.groggy: Groggy starts (after the revert landing): spent, deflating cue.
sounds.chain_reform: Crescent chain re-forms at her side (after the groggy turn): plates clink into place.
sounds.dew_spawn: A 달빛 이슬 heal orb appears.
sounds.cure_chime: 달빛 고치 removed by a heal: bright rising chime burst (beam, burst, emblem): an A-major chord of note-block bell and chimes (pitch 1.19 / 1.5 / 1.78) and amethyst chimes over the beacon swell, with a sparkle and a shimmering tail.
sounds.death: Death: stagger, the wings shatter, she kneels and dissolves (no voices).
sounds.death_motes: Death tail: the last motes rise.
